text:
evan: Heads-up — PR #645 adds a short 'Optimize: migration tips' blurb (batching + kv prefetch + quant profile). Need a quick docs sanity pass and a tiny 3-line checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood/optimize/pull/645 :link:
anya: Looking now. Keep examples copy-pasteable and under ~10 lines. Add a one-line cost heuristic.
marta: Here's a tiny Python v2 snippet showing batch + kv prefetch (copy-first):
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key='${REDWOOD}')
outs = client.batch.text.generate([
  {'model':'redwood/opt-mini','prompt':'Summarize logs'},
  {'model':'redwood/opt-mini','prompt':'List errors'}
], options={'kv_prefetch': True})
for o in outs: print(o.text)
```
kevin: Suggested compact quant YAML to include in docs. Call out a fallback for very short inputs to avoid probability drift:
```yaml
precision: q8_0
kv_prefetch: true
shortseq_fallback:
  threshold_tokens: 12
  fallback_precision: float32
```
kevin: Add a short note: "q8_0 often reduces memory ~2.5-3.5x; test on a held-out prompt set."
evan: Can someone run a tiny smoke eval (10 prompts float32 vs q8_0) and paste tokens/cost delta in PR comments? Even a small 3-row table is fine.
anya: I'll run it and paste numbers by EOD. Quick editorial nit: prefer single quotes in snippets and avoid extra inline comments.
marta: Small Node snippet for the docs (batch + non-streaming):
```js
const { Client } = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD })
const res = await client.batch.text.generate([
  { model: 'redwood/opt-mini', prompt: 'Summarize logs' },
  { model: 'redwood/opt-mini', prompt: 'List errors' }
], { kv_prefetch: true })
res.forEach(r => console.log(r.outputText))
```
ci-bot: label applied: docs/needs-review
kevin: One troubleshooting tip to add: if short prompts show quality regression, raise shortseq_fallback.threshold_tokens or temporarily use float32 for that route. Link to Eval playbook.
evan: Great. Proposed 3-line checklist in PR description: 1) update SDK snippets (py/js) to v2 batch API, 2) include compact quant YAML + shortseq fallback, 3) run 10-prompt smoke eval and paste token/cost delta.
anya: LGTM — I'll push a tiny wording tweak to the PR.
evan: Thanks all. On merge, ci-bot please post a changelog blurb and ping #release-war-room with the checklist attached.
ci-bot: will publish changelog and notify #release-war-room on merge.
